### Added

- (agent-platform) [Connect Claude and Gemini on Vertex AI in the model form](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3014) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson) — `Connect a model` offers `Claude on Vertex AI` and `Gemini on Vertex AI`, set up with a `Location` and a Google Cloud service account key file, whose project the model uses. Needs agent-platform 4.128.0 or later; the LLM gateway does not meter these models.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/compare/v3.5.0...v3.6.0
